content:
Returns the data for the specified dashboard widget.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
QUERY PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "customer_licensing_data"
"scan_results"
The dashboard widget you want to retrieve data for. You can retrieve data
for two dashboard widgets:
customer_licensing_data—This widget provides a quick list of
customer accounts and their basic licensing snapshot.
scan_results—This widget provides a list of customer accounts and
some high level scan metadata for each one.
